_comment: Hand-maintained. The ONLY place annual-report figures live — the dashboard tracker, stats and crime chart all render from this file. When ASD publishes a new Annual Cyber Threat Report (the 'annual report watch' workflow opens an issue), update every value here from the new report and check the page. The fy/fy_slug values also tell the watcher which report comes next.
